steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const W=g.world; const s=W.fallsS; const f=W.river.sample(s); const d=W.river.sample(s+60); const off=W.riverWidth(s+60)+3; const x=d.x+d.tz*off, z=d.z-d.tx*off; g.player.place(x,z,0); g.player.yaw=Math.atan2(-(f.x-x),-(f.z-z)); g.player.pitch=0.1; g.env.setTime(16.5); document.getElementById('hud').hidden=true; return 'falls view from '+Math.hypot(f.x-x,f.z-z).toFixed(0)+' m'})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const W=g.world; document.getElementById('hud').hidden=false; __rhf.god(true); g.env.setTime(15); const p=g.world.place('landing'); g.player.place(p.x,p.z,0); const P=g.player; const hp=W.heightAt(P.pos.x,P.pos.z); let yaw=null; for(let a=0;a<48;a++){ const ang=a/48*Math.PI*2; let ok=true; for(const r of [10,20,30,36]){ const x=P.pos.x-Math.sin(ang)*r, z=P.pos.z-Math.cos(ang)*r; if(W.waterAt(x,z)||Math.abs(W.heightAt(x,z)-hp)>1.6){ok=false;break;} } if(ok){yaw=ang;break;} } if(yaw===null) return 'no flat line'; P.yaw=yaw; g.state.stats.caught=3; g.bears.stage(P.pos); const b=g.bears.bears.find(b=>b.state==='stalk'); if(!b) return 'no stalker'; b.x=P.pos.x-Math.sin(yaw)*36; b.z=P.pos.z-Math.cos(yaw)*36; window.__bear=b; g.player.tool='rifle'; g.viewmodel.setTool('rifle'); return 'staged at landing yaw '+yaw.toFixed(2)})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const b=__bear; const P=g.player; for(let i=0;i<900;i++){ const dx=b.x-P.pos.x, dz=b.z-P.pos.z; const d=Math.hypot(dx,dz); P.yaw=Math.atan2(-dx,-dz); P.pitch=Math.max(-0.12, Math.atan2(b.y+0.9-(P.pos.y+P.eye), d)); if(d<15) return 'bear at '+d.toFixed(1)+' state '+b.state; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,25)); } return 'bear never came '+b.state})()
